notes.title: Update v0.135
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/28bd8e08dc61ca0aea194992cae5833cf31226a4.jpg[/img]

We have fixed a few minor bugs and improved the user-friendliness in some places.

[list]
[*] Verbesserung der Multi-Objekttexturen und Multi-Objektmodelle Steuerung
[*] Verbesserte Game Manager Download Anzeige
[*] Fehler behoben bei der Sortierung von mehreren Fenstern auf dem Bildschirm
[*] Selektion mehrerer Objekte kann jetzt durch ESC aufgehoben werden
[/list]

Create your own interesting game elements in a flash, which can be dynamically customised at runtime.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/37574c54af1ca22c21e41eaa33cfe7db9055a2c2.jpg[/img]

There are now new controls for multitextures in the object menu ring and in-app help on how to edit objects with multitextures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/51813e66f85989fcec15e9e7caba615a85097aa7.jpg[/img]

The whole thing also works with 3D models, which can be seamlessly loaded into the same object to achieve great effects, such as opening doors, treasure chests or similar objects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/43b8db0938c83287539e8c82ba8f80005d0a519e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update v0.134
notes.content:
[h2]VBR Update v0.134 - The Deckmaker[/h2]

Before the holidays, we have a gift for all users and VBR fans. The Christmas update includes a new tool, the Deckmaker. This allows you to create databases of objects that offer completely new possibilities for organizing, managing and building your digital games. Find out more about these great new possibilities in our Deckmaker tutorial video:

[previewyoutube=WjlAwvNf8-k;full][/previewyoutube]

Create databases from VBO files and generate new decks for your trading card games:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/a1d570beeebed77d039997316c0ae242192bbaee.jpg[/img]

Assign keywords to each entry to filter and structure your lists:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/5598c176a84671176f0df5fbbb5a24011c236048.jpg[/img]

Use different views to get a quick overview of your data:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/20fdc8dd5aec364f35bb0713fb20b5c896bc682c.jpg[/img]

Create, save and load stacks of objects (decks) and have the corresponding objects generated directly in the VBR. This way, everyone can quickly and easily contribute their individual masterpiece to a game round:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/96e8236559e3f0117e3b8fc0541dc2d0c21e3811.jpg[/img]

With the histogram view, you can analyze your decks and estimate their performance:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/226ce14b30fc9878c80e4a6550c30ee2dfc4dd96.jpg[/img]

The GUI elements have been enhanced with high-resolution textures to adapt them to modern systems. Many small improvements are intended to enhance the user experience:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/a3b67264734f13727aa4f0a8f75e957b3d75216e.jpg[/img]

[i](The playing cards shown are demonstration elements and are not included in the VBR.)[/i]

[h3]We wish everyone a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year.[/h3]

notes.title: Walk the Plank
notes.content:
[h1]Walk the Plank[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/f8ceaa9ec0344a3ec9fae8501c72b9762510b3d7.jpg[/img]

YarrHarr! That is the cry of the pirates as they drop anchor in the small lagoon to bring the treasures they have just captured to safety in their hiding place. But what is that? Suddenly their proud ship tilts to the side and threatens to capsize. The privateers have distributed their cargo poorly in the ship's hull and now everything is sliding back and forth and swaying dangerously. Will they manage to find their balance again and distribute their stolen gold in such a way that they sail in safe waters?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/c43e3b540ce87a660e6c2aa27d18daa94ebb86aa.jpg[/img]

Download this game exclusively for the VBR via the internal Game Manager.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/ee5d5a167c219d4bf2b0566a1982bf722418b57f.jpg[/img]

Have fun balancing.

notes.title: Version v0.133
notes.content:
Version 0.133 of the VBR brings some exciting new game elements and many small improvements and bug fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/a6191ad64ef1d4b0649d184269be8894438eecfd.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Gear system for creating interactive, moving game elements
[*] New special object: The Magnet
[*] Quick-Info-Frame: For quickly capturing object properties during creation and in the game.
[*] Many bugfixes and usability improvements
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/a46c00dc27389236151f983bbfcf42d73c883289.jpg[/img]

With the new gear system, great and exciting ideas can be implemented and some things in the VBR can become more interactive.

[previewyoutube=uSeES_q66MQ;full][/previewyoutube]

---

You can do all sorts of crazy and useful things with the new magnet object. Especially in combination with other objects such as the spinner or gluing elements together, unique board game functions can be created.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/d5ea456e18c847aef76ba563865253ad57a62838.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/0a1193ae44bfc73b664c3cc1f3771e843777d155.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=f_VNL2H-Vvk;full][/previewyoutube]

---

The Quick-Info-Frame brings a whole new level of clarity to the VBR. Identify what object it is and what its status values ​​are at the touch of a button. For container elements, the number of sub-elements is also displayed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/87c1e2da513663e5ae66ad3bb2ae54da76598749.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update v0.132
notes.content:
With the update of the VBR to version 0.132 we were able to fix some bugs and add some functions for better usability and clarity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/e12b68ebb7eadd149da33010d598fbf83eaf4f3e.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] New special object: The hourglass
[*] File Transfer for transferring self-created card decks and object collections from the client to the host system
[*] Dynamic object texture viewer in the Deck Manager
[*] Preview logo for game files in the File Manager
[*] Consistent use of the oversize function for text field entries
[*] Bug fixes and usability adjustments
[/list]

Let the time trickle and run away. Now you can do this in style with a functioning hourglass directly in the VBR.

---

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/1d0c50f2a58392bf897fe1ae2aacebc1fe38814a.jpg[/img]

Create your own decks of cards and share them with the host system to make them available to all players.

---

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/4e8b1eb077e8644da1af4bf5ae1e6b2b02284fea.jpg[/img]

Get an even faster overview of the contents of containers, display the textures of objects and use the Ctrl key to simply move the mouse cursor over them and get a quick preview.

---

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/8669867f9b87203d20149d4302390f221e4f2101.jpg[/img]

Keep track and create your own little reminders of your saved games and objects with the file image preview.

notes.title: VBR v0.131
notes.content:
Version 0.131 of the virtual board game room brings a number of new features. Check out the list of all new features here.

[list]
[*] PDF files can now be opened directly via the file loading window. (A PDF viewer is still required on your device.)
[*] The object build menu has been redesigned. Now you can preview the objects and drag and drop them into the 3D world of the VBR.
[*] The special object "Timer" has been added. This means you always have an overview of your playing time and individual game timers. The timer can be operated forwards and backwards and has an alarm function.
[*] Objects in groups can now be aligned in a useful way. With the touch of a button, you can group them into a row or a stack.
[*] The Game Manager now has a search function and also shows the date of the last update of an additional content.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/18d01d89f0cb073605983abe0c9cf5ad67aa6d4f.png[/img]
Read the manuals of your games easily and conveniently as PDF.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/6103734d5ef9aeb12a0d54454c2983b90592233c.jpg[/img]
Creating objects has never been easier. Simply drag the game materials from the Build menu onto the playing field.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/e5f3cb4f49d8960b0ffef89e937f4e5c88281e0b.jpg[/img]
Stop the time or let a timer run until the alarm sounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/590c02b94d3c8f7b6651e18b553d4d74fe15d5a3.jpg[/img]
From now on, be even faster at laying out and collecting playing cards and other small game materials.

[previewyoutube=1xOBh5nBijg;full][/previewyoutube]
A new tutorial video on alignment is available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160924/9b6d668d7fce942965da345510df9c8dc6e70b07.jpg[/img]
Keep an even better overview of your game collection and see what's new.

notes.title: VBR Update v0.130
notes.content:
The 0.13 update includes the Game Manager as a useful tool. With it you can manage your games, download new players online and even create your own game libraries. Now distributing your games is even easier.

[list]
[*] Game Manager to manage your game library
[*] Object list with editor button for direct editing of the object
[*] Object editor extended with object rotation
[*] Multi-object marker, can now also be used through objects
[/list]
